text: Splitting passes by the minute of the pass time to tell overpass geometries apart gave 22 groups and said nothing. LOOK-011 regrouped by repeat-cycle phase and found three tracks with screened mean residuals of -0.0235, +0.0159 and +0.0051 m: no track stands out on this year.
